svg.text: Artist interface: upload volumes once to adapt the system, then drop a reference + an outline and download the figure. No prompt to write.
Part 1 · Adapt — the artist uploads his volumes, runs once per series
Same pipeline and settings for every artist. Output: one LoRA per series.
Part 2 · Generate — the artist drops 2 images, downloads the figure
Runs on GPU. Parameters frozen after POC tuning. Prompt is built automatically.
one word if the outline is
drops onto the page as a layer
face + hair, out of scope by design
